subject: Re: Project Commendation & Next Steps
body:
Dear CEO Office,

Thank you for the commendation regarding the successful delivery of Phase 2. We appreciate the board's recognition.

I have received the instructions to commence Phase 3 planning and to schedule a review call. I will begin Phase 3 planning immediately to meet the Friday deadline and will coordinate to schedule the review call by the end of the week.

Best regards,
suggested_followups: Send calendar invite for review call

action_item: Schedule review call by end of week
